# scamp_volume (Resource)

Manages a volume (disk) in SCAMP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scamp_volume" "data" {
  display_name  = "web-data"
  size_gb       = 100
  storage_class = "R2"

  # Attaching is a field, not a separate resource: set it to attach, clear it
  # to detach. The disk keeps its data either way.
  attached_vm_id = scamp_vm.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `size_gb` (Number) Size of the volume in GB (1-10000).

### Optional

- `attached_vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM to attach the volume to. If not set, volume is created but not attached.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the volume (max 100 characters).
- `storage_class` (String) Name of the storage class, e.g. R2 or W3. Case does not matter. Use this or storage_class_id.
- `storage_class_id` (Number) ID of the storage class. Resolved from storage_class when that is set instead.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the volume.
- `read_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Read bandwidth limit (MB/s).
- `read_iops_limit` (Number) Read IOPS limit.
- `sds_pool_name` (String) Name of the SDS pool.
- `state` (String) State of the volume (queued, provisioning, available, attached, etc.).
- `write_bandwidth_limit` (Number) Write bandwidth limit (MB/s).
- `write_iops_limit` (Number) Write IOPS limit.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_volume.data 48f00603-0a4f-48f7-87c0-8a8742040dfe
```
